title: Physical and Mental Wellbeing
text: Our health affects everything we do—how we learn, work, and spend time with friends and family. Wellbeing includes both your body and your mind. Taking care of yourself now will help you stay happy, focused, and resilient in the future.
cdi_links: 3.B.02 Understanding physical and mental wellbeing and recognising its importance in personal and career life

title: Healthy Habits for Wellbeing
bullets: Sleep: Get enough rest each night
Relaxation: Take breaks, meditate, or listen to music
Socialising: Spend time with friends and family

title: Recognising Signs You Need Support
bullets: Avoiding tasks or losing interest in hobbies

title: Reflect and Set a Wellbeing Goal
bullets: Colour your wellbeing wheel for Sleep, Exercise, Nutrition, Relaxation, and Socialising
Identify one area you would like to improve
Set a small, realistic action to improve this area (e.g., walk 10 minutes, sleep 8 hours, talk to a friend)
Share your goal with a partner or group and reflect after a week

title: Complete the Sentence
sentence: Maintaining ______ and developing healthy ______ help you stay resilient and focused.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Wellbeing involves both physical and mental health
Small, realistic goals help develop lasting habits
Reflection and planning improve stress management
Maintaining healthy routines supports long-term resilience and focus
